parsedRationale: Deliverable meets all MUST requirements: structured plan with milestones, three API tool_calls (read_file, grep_search, apply_patch) with correct attributes, test_snippet present, patch_summary provided. The apply_patch uses a valid Codex patch envelope with '*** Begin Patch', '*** Update File', a bare '@@' hunk marker, real comment addition, and '*** End Patch', satisfying the diff formatting rule. No placeholders, no malformed envelopes, no prose-only tool lines.
